reasons.frozen_pilot: Frozen submission RTL, retained unchanged. Known diagnostics are debt, not signoff waivers.
reasons.translated_upstream: Pinned converted Ibex/interface bundle. Exact diagnostics and source hashes must match; no global suppression.
reasons.UNUSEDPARAM: Generated memory map and parameter alternatives; exact unused identifiers retained.
reasons.UNUSEDSIGNAL: Reserved address/data bits, unused observations or optional interfaces; exact bit ranges retained.
reasons.PINCONNECTEMPTY: Explicitly unconnected optional outputs; exact pin names retained.
reasons.DECLFILENAME: Drop-in ibex_register_file_ff replacement deliberately keeps the upstream module name.
reasons.GENUNNAMED: Legacy general-timer source selection; retain hierarchy names for reproducibility.
reasons.LATCH: Only three en_latch signals of the behavioural low-phase clock-gate model; physical cell qualification separate.
reasons.SYNCASYNCNET: Only named asynchronous-assert synchronous-release reset shift chains; not a CDC/STA waiver.
reasons.CAN_IMPLICIT: Pinned can_top uses a one-bit implicit rx_inter wire from can_bsp output to can_btl input; it is driven, not an undeclared external input. Exact warning retained without editing the pristine checkout.
reasons.ETH_SELRANGE: Disabled AXI ID/DEST lanes and disabled PTP TUSER-control branches are still parsed. The selected MAC disables these features; this allowance does not apply to a profile that enables them.
reasons.SRAM_BLACKBOX: The checked IHP macro interface declarations have no behavioural driver; UNDRIVEN/UNUSEDSIGNAL warnings belong to lint-only macro interfaces. Functional macro behaviour is exercised by the independent native-model parity suite.
